x: This race was marked by the appearance of Abdon Pamich (Italy) the European 50 Kilos Champion 1962, who was paying a short visit to this country.
Besides last years champion, South African George Hazle, there were three Olympic gold medallists taking part - Abdon Pamich, Don Thompson and Norman Read.
In addition, after almost 4½ hours of walking he was only 4¼ minutes behind the winner, the reigning Olympic and European Champion Abdon Pamich and a mere 134 seconds short of a bronze medal.

Ray made his usual cautious start but then moved up to second place behind the Italian Olympic and European Champion Abdon Pamich.
